column3: We need to discuss this issue at the next meeting. (我們需要在下次會議討論這個問題。)
The road construction caused a major disruption to traffic. (道路施工造成了嚴重的交通中斷。)
The heavy rain will delay our flight by two hours. (大雨會讓我們的航班延誤兩小時。)
Please call the hotel to cancel your room reservation. (請打電話給飯店取消你的訂房。)
There is a lot of activity at the office today. (辦公室今天有很多活動。)
The gym has new equipment for all the members. (健身房有供所有會員使用的新器材。)
The soldier was wounded during the training exercise. (士兵在訓練演習中受傷了。)
Have you seen the latest report on our sales? (你看過我們最新的銷售報告了嗎？)
The two cars collided at the busy intersection. (兩輛車在繁忙的十字路口相撞了。)
Can you identify the person in this photo? (你能認出這張照片裡的人是誰嗎？)
